title: Posting Attribution
description: posting-attribution/v1 — the document a posting-attribution event carries. It joins a live ledger movement to the report it satisfies, which is what lets every organization's earmark fold attribute the movement to the right obligation from the shared log alone. Declared by the posting party as part of the same operation that started the transfer, so it can exist before the transfer settles.

executionPlanId.description: The execution plan carrying the movement. The join key: the fold matches receipts to reports through it.

assetId.description: Asset moved. Absent on attributions that name only the plan.

quantity.description: Quantity moved, as a decimal string.

negotiationId.description: The agreed negotiation thread this posting executes, when the report is fulfilled through negotiation rather than directly.

purpose.description: `settlement` marks the receiver's counter-payment leg. Absent means a collateral leg — the settlement asset may equal an eligible line's asset, so (reportId, assetId) alone would be ambiguous without this.
